newsitem.title: USA: Thor to begin Dutch auction tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Thor to begin Dutch auction tender offer.

text.p: Recreational vehicle manufacturer Thor Industries Inc said on Thursday it would start a Dutch auction tender offer for up to 500,000 shares of its common stock.

The tender price would range from $24 to $26 per share, it said. The maximum cost of the offer would be $13 million and would be paid from cash and cash equivalents, borrowings under its existing bank agreement, or some combination of the two, the company said.

As of October 16, Thor had cash and cash equivalents of about $4 million, about $15.5 million in available borrowings and no long term debt. The offer would not be contingent upon any minimum number of shares being tendered, it said.
